value.quote: a method of detecting gerrymandering that can be applied to such
value.note: The paper studies districting manipulation of FPTP elections, a strategic aspect of a voting procedure. Its main object is a statistical detection method, which makes eligibility borderline.

C0.reason: The paper defines gerrymandering as manipulation of district boundaries in FPTP elections and simulates seat-maximising districting plans, so it studies a strategic aspect of a voting procedure, the kind of districting the codebook's DIS stakeholder type covers.

value.quote: development of a nonparametric methods for detecting gerrymandering
value.note: OT: proposal of a statistical detection methodology, which the paper calls its main contribution. SI: Monte Carlo observation and tests on simulated districting plans. EM: application to real election datasets.

C1.reason: The paper presents its main contribution as a methodological proposal (OT); the simulation and empirical tests are secondary validations, so OT is the primary type.
